parameters.name: DBInstanceId
parameters.description: The instance ID. You can call the DescribeDBInstances operation to query the instance IDs.

parameters.name: DBProxyConnectString
parameters.description: The proxy connection string. You can call the DescribeDBProxy operation to query this connection string.

parameters.name: DBProxyEndpointId
parameters.description: The ID of the proxy endpoint. You can call the DescribeDBProxy operation to query this ID.

parameters.name: DBProxyEngineType
parameters.description: This parameter is reserved and does not need to be specified.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID. You can call the DescribeRegions operation to query the most recent region list.
